journey.what_i_notice: Top navigation bar with links: HOME, NEW ARRIVALS, EARRINGS, NECKLACES, BRACELETS, RINGS, MEN'S JEWELLERY, SHOP ALL, Log in, Cart.
journey.customer_thought: I can jump straight to the product categories I’m interested in.

journey.what_i_notice: Long promotional copy: 18K gold plated, "Buy 2 or more, get up to 50% off", "No code needed", "Save ₹120 more on prepaid orders + express delivery" repeated several times.
journey.customer_thought: There is a big discount if I buy multiple items, and I might save on shipping if I pay prepaid.
journey.information_gap: Which specific products qualify, how the 50% is calculated, and what the final price (including shipping) will be.
journey.next_information_needed: Detailed pricing table showing regular price, discount amount per SKU, and shipping cost breakdown.
journey.reason: Discount terms are vague; I need concrete numbers to compare.

journey.what_i_notice: Product snippets with regular and sale prices (e.g., Halo Cuff Bracelet ₹1,500 → ₹1,425) and a few positive review excerpts.
journey.customer_thought: Some items are on sale, and other shoppers like the quality.

journey.next_information_needed: Full product pages with price, shipping, and bundle information.
journey.reason: Price hints are useful but incomplete for my total‑cost comparison.
